comments.author: Destry1
comments.body:
The update info says "Report your Weather/Phenomena Discoveries to Robert Boyle at the Oxford College to receive special rewards!"

I have only gotten landmark ribbons as extra reward, and reported 16 of the 20 phenomena so far. I must admit that I was hoping for something more impressive.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
At the risk of stirring up further ill sentiments after the Pirate King Charm fiasco (which still stings), I think I know what the problem is. See, Robert Boyle's rewards in Japan were a bit different:

www.gamecity.ne.jp/dol/age_of_revolution/chapter1_3.htm

It looks like he gave out one "Report reward redemption ticket" for each weather/phenom discovery, which could randomly turn into (at the very least) one of three Astro-only items: the Adventure skill +3 add on, the 30% sailing speed increase for an hour, and an Aide Adventure EXP booster. It may have other possible random lotto drops, but I'm not going to dig any further since it doesn't really matter at this point.

Now, when OGP/KOEI/whoever was translating the original Japanese text into English, copying the update pages verbatim, as they always seem to do, somebody left the "special rewards" message in place, even though someone else had the bright idea to substitute Boyle's random lotto ticket item with... yeah. Landmark ribbons. Not really a very good replacement prize.

I don't see myself rushing to turn in any of my discoveries in that field now. Maybe OGP (and their masters at KOEI) would be willing to listen to suggestions of replacement items (even QMPs would be an improvement over ribbons). Can't hurt to ask, I say.

comments.author: Destry1
comments.body:
Thanks Guilder for the info. I must've overlooked that piece of translated information before.

The rewards on the Japanese server aren't that impressive either, so it doesn't matter too much. I thought they may have replaced it with fun equipment. They could have just left out this part of the update :)

You still get the QMP for each weather/phenomena reported, but they are hardly necessary, because one of the best part of this update are the cheap QMP's from the guild shop.

comments.author: Kossmynn
comments.body: regarding the new weather/phenomenon discoveries I can only say I'm happy they didn't add a new skill for them (which could have been a pain not only to our skill slots, but also for grinding- taking into consideration the amount of real time needed to make a discovery). Indeed the rewards from Boyle are lame and, like Guilder said, I won't rush into reporting them. In this way, I'll also avoid receiving the notification of a strange phenomenon happening nearby every time I enter a sea zone/landing point where there is one to be found. However, for those up for the challenge, this could be a good way to get to 85 adventure :) In the mean time, I do advise the adventurers to get them as fast as possible- always nice to have 20 extra cards in our deck, right?
